reason: I'd poke at the free plan, but I won't pay 99 a month for 'AI co-workers' when the page just says 'CRM, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365...' and never tells me whether it plugs into my HubSpot and Zapier setup or what a credit actually buys. I already patch my follow-up gap with Make for a lot less.
objection: 100 credits a month means nothing to me. If one follow-up email burns a credit I'm out by week two, and I don't see a real integrations list, so I can't tell if this replaces my stack or just adds another tool next to it.
would_change_my_mind: A public integrations list with native HubSpot and Zapier/Make support, plus a plain example of how many lead follow-ups 100 credits covers, proven by the free plan catching a lead I would have lost.
